info.title: maily
info.description: Local multi-provider temporary-email API. Most endpoints require the `X-API-Key` header (see Admin → API key in the dashboard).

get.description:
Brief liveness + degradation view for monitoring.

`status` mirrors the previous shape; `domain_cache` reports per-provider
last refresh time, cached domain count and the latest refresh error.

Non-secret server facts for the dashboard and the standalone client.

This router is auth-free: `client_version` lets a pip-installed client
detect it should run `python -m client update`.
Check if a new version is available on GitHub.

schema.title: Response Check Updates V1 Updates Check Get

get.description: OAuth redirect target (browser flow). Not for direct use.

post.description: Manually complete OAuth when browser callback is unreachable (e.g. behind proxy).

get.description: List enabled providers and their kind (api/token or domain-based).

schema.title: Response List Providers V1 Providers Get

get.description: List usable posting targets, optionally filtered by provider slug.

schema.title: Response List Targets V1 Targets Get

post.description: Manually complete OAuth when browser callback is unreachable (e.g. behind proxy).

get.description: List connected Gmail accounts (expired ones included for reconnection).

schema.title: Response List Accounts V1 Gmail Accounts Get

delete.description: Disconnect a linked Gmail account the caller owns.

post.description: Refresh profile/token state for a linked Gmail account the caller owns.
Create a disposable mailbox on a provider (optionally with a specific address/password).

get.description: List mailboxes with optional provider/status filtering, address search and pagination.

parameters.name: q

schema.description: Substring filter on the full address
schema.title: Q

parameters.description: Substring filter on the full address

schema.title: Response List Mailboxes V1 Mailboxes Get

get.description: Look up a mailbox by its full email address.
Fetch a single mailbox by id.

delete.description: Deactivate and mark a mailbox deleted (also deletes it upstream).

get.description: List a mailbox's messages (fetches one page from the provider and caches it).

schema.title: Response List Messages V1 Mailboxes  Mailbox Id  Messages Get

get.description: Fetch a single message with its full text and HTML bodies.

delete.description: Delete a message (upstream and local cache).

post.description: Mark a message as read (both upstream and locally).

get.description: Download the raw message source (.eml payload).

Dashboard stats: mailbox/message totals, provider split, 7-day trend,
and a 10-day activity history that also covers retention-deleted items.

schema.title: Response Stats V1 Admin Stats Get

get.description: List active TTL retention rules. Root reads the global table.

schema.title: Response List Retention V1 Admin Retention Get

put.description: Create or update TTL retention for a provider (at least one TTL required).

delete.description: Disable retention rules for a provider.

post.description:
Run the retention cleanup sweep right now. A key sweeps only its mailboxes.

Pass `force_maintenance=true` to force full database maintenance (VACUUM,
REINDEX, ANALYZE, WAL checkpoints, quick_check) immediately regardless of the
configured throttling interval.

schema.title: Response Run Retention Sweep V1 Admin Retention Run Post

get.description: Domain cache settings and per-provider state.

post.description: Force a domain cache refresh; 502 with a failed list when a provider errors.

get.description: Current Gmail OAuth credentials (env or the encrypted store).

put.description: Save Gmail OAuth credentials to the encrypted store.

get.description: Any authenticated principal. Root is {is_root: true}; an issued key gets its own row without a secret.

schema.title: Response Me V1 Admin Keys Me Get

post.description: Root only. Returns the new row plus the secret once.

get.description: Root only. Lists every key without secret material.

schema.title: Response List Keys V1 Admin Keys Get

get.description: Root only. Returns one key without secret material.

patch.description: Root only. Updates name, expires_at, and scope. Does not change the secret.

delete.description: Root only. 204, or 409 when the key still owns a live mailbox or gmail account.

get.description: Root only. Decrypts the stored secret. Repeat calls return the same plaintext.

put.description: Root only. Replaces that key's key_retention rows.

schema.title: Response Replace Retention V1 Admin Keys  Key Id  Retention Put

post.description: Root only. Returns a new secret once. The key id does not change.

CreatedKeyOut.title: CreatedKeyOut
CreatedKeyOut.description: Create or rotate result. secret is present only on these responses.

IssuedMeOut.title: IssuedMeOut
IssuedMeOut.description: GET /me for an issued key. No secret and no secret_enc.

KeyCreateIn.title: KeyCreateIn
KeyCreateIn.description: POST /v1/admin/keys body. root_key is filled by the router, not the client.

KeyOut.title: KeyOut
KeyOut.description: Key row without secret or secret_enc.

KeyRetentionIn.title: KeyRetentionIn
KeyRetentionIn.description: One key_retention row in a full replacement list.

KeyRetentionOut.title: KeyRetentionOut
KeyRetentionOut.description: One stored key_retention row. No secret material.

KeyScopeIn.title: KeyScopeIn
KeyScopeIn.description: Write-time scope. Unknown parent ids are stored, not checked.

KeyUpdateIn.title: KeyUpdateIn
KeyUpdateIn.description: PATCH body. Does not include the secret or retention rows.

RootMeOut.title: RootMeOut
RootMeOut.description: GET /me for the env root key.
